subject.title: refactor: replace hardcoded ~/.openclaw paths with resolveStateDir()

question: For QQBot media paths, should the established `OPENCLAW_HOME`-rooted behavior remain authoritative, or should this PR deliberately migrate it to `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`?
rationale: The changed module documents the existing `OPENCLAW_HOME` behavior for Docker and multi-user hosts, while the new resolver changes that compatibility contract; the intended precedence cannot be safely inferred from a refactor alone.

options.title: Preserve QQBot home behavior
options.body: Resolve the conflicts while retaining `OPENCLAW_HOME` for QQBot media, and limit the state-directory conversion to paths without that established contract.

options.title: Adopt state-directory routing
options.body: Make QQBot media follow `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, document the resulting upgrade behavior, and add migration or compatibility proof for existing media paths.

recommendation.title: Preserve QQBot home behavior
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflicts while retaining `OPENCLAW_HOME` for QQBot media, and limit the state-directory conversion to paths without that established contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR’s explicit review request and timeline routing identify steipete as the best available person to decide the intended compatibility contract.
